name: Real Consulting S.A.
summary: Real Consulting S.A. provides IT solutions in Europe. It is involved in the development, processing, installation, distribution, and marketing of software systems and programs, as well as in providing integrated IT solutions and distribution of networking products. The company also offers customer experience, employee experience, enterprise resource management, enterprise management, and enterprise performance management. It serves energy and utilities, healthcare and life sciences, consumer products, manufacturing, retail, public sector, and financial and services. Real Consulting S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
